// Probe for tests/unit/account-creation-behind-gate.test.ts.
//
// Copy to app/api/probe-signup/route.ts (as .ts) and run that test: it MUST
// fail, naming this file as able to create an account without importing the registration gate. Delete the copy afterwards.
//
// This is the fifth door — a new "public signup" endpoint that looks harmless
// because it validates its input and rate-limits itself, and mints accounts
// while the product is advertising that registrations are paused.

import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server"

export async function POST(request: Request) {
    const { email, password } = await request.json()

    const supabase = await createClient()
    await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })

    const user = await db.user.create({
        data: { email, name: email.split("@")[0], roles: "policyholder" },
    })

    return Response.json({ id: user.id })
}
